== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Golds represent a classification of individuals or beings defined by their level of power and [[advancement]]. This hierarchy includes several distinct ranks, such as Lowgold{{!}}Lowgolds, Highgold{{!}}Highgolds, and Truegold{{!}}Truegolds, with the latter often serving in leadership roles like squad leaders. Within these ranks, individuals may possess unique visual manifestations known as Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns. The term also applies to Gold dragons{{!}}gold dragons, which have historically been viewed as tyrannical rulers due to their long periods of unopposed power. In combat and societal roles, Golds can serve as defenders, utilizing their abilities to fuel defensive Script{{!}}script networks or bolster boundary fields. They are also found in various professional capacities, including [[sacred artists]] and combatants in organized fighting circuits.}}
